verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν ἤρξατο διδάσκειν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πλεῖστος ὄχλος συνάγεται πρὸς αὐτὸν ὥστε αὐτὸν ἐμβάντα εἰς πλοῖον καθῆσθαι ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἦσαν πρὸς τὴν θάλασσαν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai palin ērxato didaskein para tēn thalassan kai pleistos ochlos synagetai pros auton hōste auton embanta eis ploion kathēsthai en tē thalassē kai pas ho ochlos ēsan pros tēn thalassan epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: [Once] again [Jesus] began to teach beside the sea and [such] a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into . . . a boat [and] sat in - [it] while all the people crowded . . . . . . . . . along the shore

verses.original: Καὶ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς πολλά ἐν παραβολαῖς καὶ ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ διδαχῇ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai edidasken autous polla en parabolais kai en autou tē didachē elegen autois
verses.literal: And He taught them many things in parables and in His - teaching He said -

verses.original: Ἀκούετε ἰδοὺ ὁ σπείρων ἐξῆλθεν σπεῖραι
verses.transliteration: Akouete idou ho speirōn exēlthen speirai
verses.literal: Listen . . . A farmer went out to sow his seed

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ σπείρειν μὲν ὃ ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ ἦλθεν καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτό
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en tō speirein men ho epesen para tēn hodon kai ta peteina ēlthen kai katephagen auto
verses.literal: And - as - he was sowing - some [seed] fell along the path and the birds came and devoured it

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλο ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸ πετρῶδες ὅπου οὐκ εἶχεν πολλήν γῆν καὶ ἐξανέτειλεν εὐθὺς διὰ γῆς μὴ τὸ ἔχειν βάθος
verses.transliteration: Kai allo epesen epi to petrōdes hopou ouk eichen pollēn gēn kai exaneteilen euthys dia gēs mē to echein bathos
verses.literal: - Some fell on - rocky ground where vvv it did not have much soil - It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: καὶ ὅτε ὁ ἥλιος ἀνέτειλεν ἐκαυματίσθη καὶ ἐξηράνθη διὰ τὸ ἔχειν μὴ ῥίζαν
verses.transliteration: kai hote ho hēlios aneteilen ekaumatisthē kai exēranthē dia to echein mē rhizan
verses.literal: But when the sun rose [the seedlings] were scorched and they withered because - they had no root

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλο ἔπεσεν εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας καὶ αἱ ἄκανθαι ἀνέβησαν καὶ συνέπνιξαν αὐτό καὶ ἔδωκεν οὐκ καρπὸν
verses.transliteration: Kai allo epesen eis tas akanthas kai hai akanthai anebēsan kai synepnixan auto kai edōken ouk karpon
verses.literal: - Other [ seed ] fell among - thorns - - [which] grew up and choked [the seedlings] and [they] yielded no crop

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλα ἔπεσεν εἰς τὴν τὴν καλήν γῆν ἀναβαίνοντα καὶ αὐξανόμενα καὶ ἐδίδου καρπὸν καὶ ἓν ἔφερεν τριάκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑξήκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑκατόν
verses.transliteration: Kai alla epesen eis tēn tēn kalēn gēn anabainonta kai auxanomena kai edidou karpon kai hen epheren triakonta kai hen hexēkonta kai hen hekaton
verses.literal: Still other [seed] fell on - - good soil [where it] sprouted - grew up and produced a crop - one bearing thirtyfold - another sixtyfold and another a hundredfold

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν Ὃς ἔχει ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen Hos echei ōta akouein akouetō
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said He who has ears to hear let him hear

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο κατὰ μόνας τοῖς δώδεκα σὺν οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν ἠρώτων αὐτὸν τὰς παραβολάς
verses.transliteration: Kai hote egeneto kata monas tois dōdeka syn hoi peri auton ērōtōn auton tas parabolas
verses.literal: As soon as . . . [Jesus] was vvv alone [with] the Twelve and those around Him they asked Him [about] the parable

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς τὸ μυστήριον τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ δέδοται Ὑμῖν δὲ ἐκείνοις τοῖς ἔξω τὰ πάντα γίνεται ἐν παραβολαῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen autois to mystērion tēs basileias tou Theou dedotai Hymin de ekeinois tois exō ta panta ginetai en parabolais
verses.literal: - He replied - The mystery of the kingdom - of God has been given to you but to those - on the outside - everything is expressed in parables

verses.original: ἵνα Βλέποντες βλέπωσιν καὶ μὴ ἴδωσιν Καὶ ἀκούοντες ἀκούωσιν καὶ μὴ συνιῶσιν Μή‿ ποτε ἐπιστρέψωσιν Καὶ ἀφεθῇ αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: hina Blepontes blepōsin kai mē idōsin Kai akouontes akouōsin kai mē syniōsin Mē pote epistrepsōsin Kai aphethē autois
verses.literal: so that vvv they may be ever seeing [but] never perceiving and vvv ever hearing [but] never understanding otherwise . . . they might turn and be forgiven . . .

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Οὐκ οἴδατε ταύτην τὴν παραβολὴν καὶ πῶς γνώσεσθε πάσας τὰς παραβολὰς
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autois Ouk oidate tautēn tēn parabolēn kai pōs gnōsesthe pasas tas parabolas
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said to them vvv Do you not understand this - parable Then how will you understand [any of] the parables

verses.original: Ὁ σπείρων σπείρει τὸν λόγον
verses.transliteration: Ho speirōn speirei ton logon
verses.literal: The farmer sows the word

verses.original: δέ οὗτοι εἰσιν οἱ παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ὅπου ὁ λόγος σπείρεται καὶ εὐθὺς ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν ὁ Σατανᾶς ἔρχεται καὶ αἴρει τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐσπαρμένον εἰς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: de houtoi eisin hoi para tēn hodon hopou ho logos speiretai kai euthys hotan akousōsin ho Satanas erchetai kai airei ton logon ton esparmenon eis autous
verses.literal: - [Some] are like the [seeds] along the path where the word is sown - As soon as . . . they hear [it] - Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them

verses.original: Καὶ οὗτοί εἰσιν ὁμοίως οἱ σπειρόμενοι ἐπὶ τὰ πετρώδη οἳ ὅταν ἀκούσωσιν τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς λαμβάνουσιν αὐτόν μετὰ χαρᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai houtoi eisin homoiōs hoi speiromenoi epi ta petrōdē hoi hotan akousōsin ton logon euthys lambanousin auton meta charas
verses.literal: - [Some] are like the [seeds] sown on - rocky ground [They] - hear the word [and] at once receive it with joy

verses.original: καὶ ἔχουσιν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς οὐκ ῥίζαν ἀλλὰ εἰσιν πρόσκαιροί εἶτα θλίψεως ἢ διωγμοῦ γενομένης διὰ τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς σκανδαλίζονται
verses.transliteration: kai echousin en heautois ouk rhizan alla eisin proskairoi eita thlipseōs ē diōgmou genomenēs dia ton logon euthys skandalizontai
verses.literal: But they themselves have . . . . . . no root [and] they remain for only a season When trouble or persecution comes because of the word vvv they quickly fall away

verses.original: Καὶ ἄλλοι εἰσὶν οἱ σπειρόμενοι εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον
verses.transliteration: Kai alloi eisin hoi speiromenoi eis tas akanthas houtoi eisin hoi akousantes ton logon
verses.literal: [Others] . . . are like the [seeds] sown among the thorns [They] . . . . . . hear the word

verses.original: καὶ αἱ μέριμναι τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἡ ἀπάτη τοῦ πλούτου καὶ αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι περὶ τὰ λοιπὰ εἰσπορευόμεναι συμπνίγουσιν τὸν λόγον καὶ γίνεται ἄκαρπος
verses.transliteration: kai hai merimnai tou aiōnos kai hē apatē tou ploutou kai hai epithymiai peri ta loipa eisporeuomenai sympnigousin ton logon kai ginetai akarpos
verses.literal: but the worries - of this life - the deceitfulness of wealth and the desire for - other things come in [and] choke the word and it becomes unfruitful

verses.original: Καὶ ἐκεῖνοί εἰσιν οἱ σπαρέντες ἐπὶ τὴν τὴν καλὴν γῆν οἵτινες ἀκούουσιν τὸν λόγον καὶ παραδέχονται καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἓν τριάκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑξήκοντα καὶ ἓν ἑκατόν
verses.transliteration: Kai ekeinoi eisin hoi sparentes epi tēn tēn kalēn gēn hoitines akouousin ton logon kai paradechontai kai karpophorousin hen triakonta kai hen hexēkonta kai hen hekaton
verses.literal: Still [others] are like the [seeds] sown on - - good soil [They] hear the word - receive [it] and produce a crop - thirtyfold - - sixtyfold [or] a hundredfold

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἔρχεται ὁ λύχνος Μήτι ἵνα τεθῇ ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον ἢ ὑπὸ τὴν κλίνην οὐχ ἵνα τεθῇ ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen autois hoti erchetai ho lychnos Mēti hina tethē hypo ton modion ē hypo tēn klinēn ouch hina tethē epi tēn lychnian
verses.literal: vvv [Jesus] also said to them - Does [anyone] bring in a lamp vvv to put [it] under - a basket or under - a bed Doesn’t - he set it on - a stand

verses.original: γάρ ἐστιν οὐ τι κρυπτὸν ἐὰν ἵνα μὴ φανερωθῇ οὐδὲ ἐγένετο ἀπόκρυφον ἀλλ’ ἵνα ἔλθῃ εἰς φανερόν
verses.transliteration: gar estin ou ti krypton ean hina mē phanerōthē oude egeneto apokryphon all’ hina elthē eis phaneron
verses.literal: For there is nothing - hidden - that will not be disclosed and nothing vvv concealed - that will [not] be brought to light

verses.original: Εἴ τις ἔχει ὦτα ἀκούειν ἀκουέτω
verses.transliteration: Ei tis echei ōta akouein akouetō
verses.literal: If anyone has ears to hear let him hear

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Βλέπετε τί ἀκούετε ἐν ᾧ μέτρῳ μετρεῖτε μετρηθήσεται ὑμῖν καὶ προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen autois Blepete ti akouete en hō metrō metreite metrēthēsetai hymin kai prostethēsetai hymin
verses.literal: - He went on to say - Pay attention to what you hear With [the] measure you [use] it will be measured to you and even more will be added to you

verses.original: γὰρ ὃς ἔχει δοθήσεται αὐτῷ καὶ ὃς οὐκ ἔχει καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar hos echei dothēsetai autō kai hos ouk echei kai ho echei arthēsetai ap’ autou
verses.literal: For whoever has will be given [more] [But] whoever vvv does not have even what he has will be taken away from him

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστὶν Οὕτως ὡς ἄνθρωπος βάλῃ τὸν σπόρον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen hē basileia tou Theou estin Houtōs hōs anthrōpos balē ton sporon epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: vvv [Jesus] also said The kingdom - of God is like . . . a man who scatters - seed on the ground

verses.original: καὶ νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν καθεύδῃ καὶ ἐγείρηται καὶ ὁ σπόρος βλαστᾷ καὶ μηκύνηται αὐτός οἶδεν οὐκ ὡς
verses.transliteration: kai nykta kai hēmeran katheudē kai egeirētai kai ho sporos blasta kai mēkynētai autos oiden ouk hōs
verses.literal: - Night and day he sleeps and wakes and the seed sprouts and grows [though] he knows not how

verses.original: αὐτομάτη ἡ γῆ καρποφορεῖ πρῶτον χόρτον εἶτα στάχυν εἶτα σῖτον πλήρης ἐν τῷ στάχυϊ
verses.transliteration: automatē hē gē karpophorei prōton chorton eita stachyn eita siton plērēs en tō stachui
verses.literal: All by itself the earth produces a crop first [the] stalk then [the] head then grain [that] ripens within . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ εὐθὺς ὅταν ὁ καρπός παραδοῖ ἀποστέλλει τὸ δρέπανον ὅτι ὁ θερισμός παρέστηκεν
verses.transliteration: de euthys hotan ho karpos paradoi apostellei to drepanon hoti ho therismos parestēken
verses.literal: And as soon as . . . the grain is ripe he swings the sickle because the harvest has come

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν Πῶς ὁμοιώσωμεν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἢ ἐν τίνι παραβολῇ θῶμεν αὐτὴν
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen Pōs homoiōsōmen tēn basileian tou Theou ē en tini parabolē thōmen autēn
verses.literal: Then He asked To what can we compare the kingdom - of God - With what parable shall we present it

verses.original: ὡς κόκκῳ σινάπεως ὃς ὅταν ὂν μικρότερον πάντων τῶν σπερμάτων σπαρῇ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: hōs kokkō sinapeōs hos hotan on mikroteron pantōn tōn spermatōn sparē epi tēs gēs tōn epi tēs gēs
verses.literal: It is like a mustard seed . . . which - is [the] smallest of all - seeds sown . . . . . . . . . - upon the earth

verses.original: καὶ ὅταν σπαρῇ ἀναβαίνει καὶ γίνεται μεῖζον πάντων τῶν λαχάνων καὶ ποιεῖ μεγάλους κλάδους ὥστε τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ δύνασθαι κατασκηνοῦν ὑπὸ αὐτοῦ τὴν σκιὰν
verses.transliteration: kai hotan sparē anabainei kai ginetai meizon pantōn tōn lachanōn kai poiei megalous kladous hōste ta peteina tou ouranou dynasthai kataskēnoun hypo autou tēn skian
verses.literal: But after it is planted it grows - to be the largest of all - garden plants and puts forth great branches so that the birds of the air - nest in its - shade

verses.original: Καὶ τοιαύταις πολλαῖς παραβολαῖς ἐλάλει τὸν λόγον αὐτοῖς καθὼς ἠδύναντο ἀκούειν
verses.transliteration: Kai toiautais pollais parabolais elalei ton logon autois kathōs ēdynanto akouein
verses.literal: - vvv With many such parables [Jesus] spoke the word to them to the extent that they could understand

verses.original: δὲ οὐκ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς χωρὶς παραβολῆς δὲ κατ’ ἰδίαν ἐπέλυεν πάντα τοῖς ἰδίοις μαθηταῖς
verses.transliteration: de ouk elalei autois chōris parabolēs de kat’ idian epelyen panta tois idiois mathētais
verses.literal: - vvv He did not tell them [anything] . . . without using a parable But vvv privately He explained everything to His own disciples

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ γενομένης ὀψίας λέγει αὐτοῖς Διέλθωμεν εἰς τὸ πέραν
verses.transliteration: Kai en ekeinē tē hēmera genomenēs opsias legei autois Dielthōmen eis to peran
verses.literal: When - that - vvv vvv evening came He said to [His disciples] Let us cross to the other side

verses.original: καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν ὄχλον παραλαμβάνουσιν αὐτὸν ὡς ἦν ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ καὶ ἦν ἄλλα πλοῖα μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai aphentes ton ochlon paralambanousin auton hōs ēn en tō ploiō kai ēn alla ploia met’ autou
verses.literal: After they had dismissed the crowd they took [Jesus] with them . . . since He was already in the boat And there were other boats with Him

verses.original: Καὶ μεγάλη λαῖλαψ ἀνέμου γίνεται καὶ τὰ κύματα ἐπέβαλλεν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον ὥστε τὸ πλοῖον ἤδη γεμίζεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Kai megalē lailaps anemou ginetai kai ta kymata epeballen eis to ploion hōste to ploion ēdē gemizesthai
verses.literal: Soon a violent windstorm . . . came up and the waves were breaking over the boat so that - [it] vvv was being swamped

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν ἐν τῇ πρύμνῃ καθεύδων ἐπὶ τὸ προσκεφάλαιον καὶ ἐγείρουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε οὐ μέλει σοι ὅτι ἀπολλύμεθα
verses.transliteration: kai autos ēn en tē prymnē katheudōn epi to proskephalaion kai egeirousin auton kai legousin autō Didaskale ou melei soi hoti apollymetha
verses.literal: But [Jesus] was in the stern sleeping on the cushion [So] they woke Him and said - Teacher vvv don’t You care . . . that we are perishing

verses.original: Καὶ διεγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ ἀνέμῳ καὶ τῇ θαλάσσῃ Σιώπα εἶπεν πεφίμωσο καὶ ὁ ἄνεμος ἐκόπασεν καὶ ἐγένετο μεγάλη γαλήνη
verses.transliteration: Kai diegertheis epetimēsen tō anemō kai tē thalassē Siōpa eipen pephimōso kai ho anemos ekopasen kai egeneto megalē galēnē
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] got up [and] rebuked the wind and the sea Silence He commanded Be still And the wind died down and it was perfectly calm

verses.original: Τί ἐστε δειλοί Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἔχετε οὔπω πίστιν
verses.transliteration: Ti este deiloi Kai eipen autois echete oupō pistin
verses.literal: Why are you so afraid - He asked - Do you still have no . . . faith

verses.original: Καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν μέγαν φόβον καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἀλλήλους Τίς ἄρα ἐστιν οὗτός ὅτι καὶ ὁ ἄνεμος καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ὑπακούει αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai ephobēthēsan megan phobon kai elegon pros allēlous Tis ara estin houtos hoti kai ho anemos kai hē thalassa hypakouei autō
verses.literal: - Overwhelmed with fear . . . . . . - they asked . . . one another Who - is this that even the wind and the sea obey Him
